_comment: Average cold rent (Kaltmiete) per m2/month, used to estimate gross rental yield for the minRoiPercent job filter. Values for muenster/aachen/tuebingen/duisburg/dortmund/bochum/goettingen/magdeburg/leipzig/chemnitz were re-derived in July 2026 from sourced price-per-sqm x reported gross-yield ranges (see the 'Where to point Fredy' research artifact); the rest are still rough starting estimates. Re-check periodically (immoscout24 Mietspiegel, empirica, local Gutachterausschuss) and edit this file freely - Fredy reloads it automatically on change.
